requirements.text: An online booking system that allows customers to select services and preferred barbers.
Automated reminders sent via SMS and email, with confirmation options included.
A simple, user-friendly interface for barbers to manage their schedules, including a calendar view and the ability to set breaks.
Daily and weekly summaries that track total appointments, cancellations, no-shows, peak times, and a breakdown of services booked.
A user-friendly system for both customers and barbers, with minimal training needed.
Customers should be able to create accounts to store their personal details and preferences.
